title: List builder
overview: Assemble a list: available vs selected, not a free-text dump.
apply_when: They must pick many items from a known set into an ordered or grouped selection.
not_when: A handful of checkboxes, or a single select.

role.overview: Assemble a list: available vs selected, not a free-text dump.
role.apply_when: They must pick many items from a known set into an ordered or grouped selection.
role.not_when: A handful of checkboxes, or a single select.

size.overview: Highest in the size hierarchy — the easiest to hit.
size.apply_when: The view's main instance, or full-width on a small viewport.
size.not_when: A dense toolbar or a third option next to the main control.

size.apply_when: Ordinary use in forms, pages, and chrome.
size.not_when: The only control on a mobile screen that should span the width.

size.overview: Lowest in the size hierarchy — densest.
size.apply_when: Inline or chrome that sits beside content.
size.not_when: The page's primary instance, or a control under 44×44.

composition.overview: Available on one side, selected on the other, with move actions.
composition.not_when: A multi select with no selected-summary.

state.not_when: Both lists empty with no empty_state.

state.overview: Keyboard is in a list or on a move action.
Move is not available (nothing selected, or locked).
state.not_when: Dropped from the tab order with no reason.

accessibility.overview: Each list has a name (Available / Selected).

keyboard.overview: Tab moves between lists and actions.
Space selects an item to move, or activates a move action.
keyboard.apply_when: A list or action is focused.
